description_target.target_text: Each black(0)/white dot sits inside one or more nested rectangular frames. Recolor the dot to the color of the smallest frame that still encloses it, leaving the frames unchanged.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define dirs4-ordered (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (obj-r1 obj) (first (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c1 obj) (second (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-r2 obj) (third (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (obj-c2 obj) (fourth (obj-bbox obj)))
    (define (norm-cells cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<))
    (define (reflect-h cells)
      (let ((maxc (apply max (map second cells))))
        (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- maxc (second p)))) cells) cell<)))
    (define (rotate-norm cells times)
      (if (= (modulo times 4) 0)
          cells
          (let* ((maxr (apply max (map first cells)))
                 (rotated (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- maxr (first p)))) cells)))
            (rotate-norm (norm-cells rotated) (- times 1)))))
    (define (lex-list< a b)
      (cond [(empty? a) (not (empty? b))]
            [(empty? b) #f]
            [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [else (lex-list< (rest a) (rest b))]))
    (define (canonical-rot cells)
      (first (sort (map (lambda (k) (rotate-norm cells k)) (range 0 4))
                   (lambda (a b) (lex-list< (apply append a) (apply append b))))))
    (define (count-equal xs value)
      (length (filter (lambda (x) (equal? x value)) xs)))
    (define (component-grid obj)
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (+ 1 (- (obj-r2 obj) (obj-r1 obj)))
                                  (+ 1 (- (obj-c2 obj) (obj-c1 obj))) 0)])
                ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
        (set-cell out (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj)) (obj-color obj))))
    (define (shape->grid cells color)
      (if (empty? cells)
          (list (list 0))
          (let ((maxr (apply max (map first cells))) (maxc (apply max (map second cells))))
            (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (+ maxr 1) (+ maxc 1) 0)])
                      ([p (in-list cells)])
              (set-cell out (first p) (second p) color)))))
    (define (perimeter obj)
      (for/sum ([p (in-list (obj-cells obj))])
        (length (filter (lambda (d)
                          (not (member? (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))) (obj-cells obj))))
                        cardinal-deltas))))
    (define (follow-wire grid start)
      (let* ((adjs (filter (lambda (p)
                             (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                  (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 1)))
                           (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first start) (first d)) (+ (second start) (second d)))) dirs4-ordered))))
        (if (empty? adjs)
            (list)
            (let loop ([cur (first adjs)] [prev start] [seen (list start)] [path (list)])
              (let* ((path2 (append path (list cur)))
                     (seen2 (append seen (list cur)))
                     (nxts (filter (lambda (p)
                                      (and (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                           (not (equal? p prev))
                                           (= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 1)
                                           (not (member? p seen2))))
                                    (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first cur) (first d)) (+ (second cur) (second d)))) dirs4-ordered))))
                (if (empty? nxts) path2 (loop (first nxts) cur seen2 path2)))))))
    (define (turn-count path)
      (if (< (length path) 3)
          0
          (let* ((dirs (for/list ([i (in-range (- (length path) 1))])
                         (let ((a (list-ref path i)) (b (list-ref path (+ i 1))))
                           (list (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second b) (second a)))))))
            (for/sum ([i (in-range (- (length dirs) 1))])
              (if (equal? (list-ref dirs i) (list-ref dirs (+ i 1))) 0 1)))))
    (define (outline-cells r1 c1 r2 c2)
      (remove-duplicates
       (append
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r1 c))
        (for/list ([c (in-range c1 (+ c2 1))]) (list r2 c))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c1))
        (for/list ([r (in-range r1 (+ r2 1))]) (list r c2)))))
    (define (frame? obj)
      (let* ((expected (outline-cells (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))
             (cells (obj-cells obj)))
        (and (= (length cells) (length expected))
             (all? (lambda (p) (member? p cells)) expected))))
    (define (frame-area-key fr)
      (* (- (obj-r2 fr) (obj-r1 fr)) (- (obj-c2 fr) (obj-c1 fr))))
    (define (detect-frames grid) (filter frame? (objects grid 0)))
    (define (fill-room-by-seed grid)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([region (in-list (find-0-regions grid 0))])
        (let* ((colors
                (remove-duplicates
                 (filter (lambda (v) (not (member? v (list 0 8))))
                         (apply append
                                (map (lambda (p)
                                       (filter values
                                               (map (lambda (d)
                                                      (let ((rr (+ (first p) (first d))) (cc (+ (second p) (second d))))
                                                        (if (in-bounds? rr cc (rows grid) (cols grid)) (at grid rr cc) #f)))
                                                    cardinal-deltas)))
                                     region))))))
          (if (= (length colors) 1) (paint-cells out region (first colors)) out))))
    (define (shortest-path grid start goal)
      (let ((prev (make-hash)) (seen (make-hash)))
        (define (rebuild cur acc)
          (if (equal? cur #f) acc (rebuild (hash-ref prev cur #f) (cons cur acc))))
        (hash-set! prev start #f)
        (hash-set! seen start #t)
        (let bfs ([queue (list start)])
          (cond [(empty? queue) (list)]
                [(equal? (first queue) goal) (rebuild goal (list))]
                [else
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (next-queue
                         (for/fold ([q (rest queue)]) ([d (in-list dirs4-ordered)])
                           (let ((nr (+ (first cur) (first d))) (nc (+ (second cur) (second d))))
                             (if (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                      (not (hash-has-key? seen (list nr nc)))
                                      (or (= (at grid nr nc) 0) (equal? (list nr nc) goal)))
                                 (begin
                                   (hash-set! seen (list nr nc) #t)
                                   (hash-set! prev (list nr nc) cur)
                                   (append q (list (list nr nc))))
                                 q)))))
                   (bfs next-queue))]))))
    (define (drop-first-last xs)
      (if (or (empty? xs) (empty? (rest xs))) (list)
          (let loop ([remaining (rest xs)] [acc (list)])
            (if (empty? (rest remaining)) acc (loop (rest remaining) (append acc (list (first remaining))))))))

    (let* ((frames (detect-frames g))
           (dots (find-color g 1)))
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([p (in-list dots)])
        (let* ((enclosing (filter (lambda (fr)
                                    (and (< (obj-r1 fr) (first p)) (< (first p) (obj-r2 fr))
                                         (< (obj-c1 fr) (second p)) (< (second p) (obj-c2 fr))))
                                  frames)))
          (if (empty? enclosing)
              out
              (let ((fr (first (sort enclosing (lambda (a b) (< (frame-area-key a) (frame-area-key b)))))))
                (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (obj-color fr)))))))
  ))
